_comment: Week 2 decision table (21_WEEK2_TIMING_CLOSURE.md 1.5 / 1.7). role: B = the UBP point that decides (60%); competitor = the pre-registered decision set (Week-2 physical model); historical = unsized designs, re-timed by the same sign-off, reported but not decision competitors; B52 = the 52% sensitivity. Fallback designs (A at 70%, P2 at 60%) are added here only if a pre-registered point fails to route. counterpart: the unsized (historical-policy) build of the same design, for the incremental flow-sizing cost of the Week-2 policy (base_def given when the build is the historical G2 one, not a ubpgen run). role failed: a pre-registered point that could not be built (reported, replaced by its fallback).
